evidence.measurement_method: One read-only recheck of stored paired outcomes; 5000 paired query resamples per slice/regime, NumPy seed20261012, 90% percentile interval. No refitting or retuning.
evidence.native_V22: Terminal runtime PASS and 400-row final-hook parity are separate from 70/400 historical complete ordering, scientific attribution and the exact official 0.335 score.
evidence.future_V23_role: Local candidate GPU F1 forward-ON plus second-list, referenced to F1=0.344; not a pure redraw of CPU V22 forward-OFF referenced to V6=0.340.
evidence.official_adoption_rule: Adopt>=0.352; reject<=0.345; otherwise inconclusive. Later <0.344 shelving shorthand is separate.
evidence.immutable_preregistration: Not proved. Local document timestamps precede subgroup rerun on an already inspected selection panel.
evidence.cohort_membership: Checked locally with outcomes excluded from mask API; no masks or query identities in this public packet.

independent_source_review.normal_and_optimized: 8 existing plus 8 independent invented test methods passed both normally and with Python -O; no actual campaign data in tests.

privacy.included: Own official result facts, scalar aggregate development diagnostics, invented synthetic inputs, original prose/code/vector diagram.
privacy.excluded: Query identifiers, spectra, target labels, per-query outcomes, private masks, checkpoints, URLs for attachments, raw receipts and source payloads.
privacy.general_caveat: Scalar aggregates for tiny cohorts or rare strata can disclose individual outcomes; explicit-record suppression is not a privacy guarantee.
